ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited delivered a landmark Q2 & H1 FY27, showcasing record-breaking consolidated revenue (+78.2% YoY H1), EBITDA (+64.7% YoY H1), and PAT (+49.6% YoY H1), underpinned by its strategic growth in indigenous defense and recent vertical integration acquisitions. However, this strong top-line and bottom-line expansion was accompanied by a contraction in consolidated margins, a persistent high working capital cycle of 353 days, and a historical trend of negative cash flow from operations, indicating significant capital intensity and potential funding pressures.
